column1: # Fake-data ensemble on the 2026-09-04 release: 32 Poisson throws of the FHC central-value prediction
# (throw_ensemble_fhc.C, unified safe-weight rule), each carried through univmake + UnfolderNuMI; pulls against the
# fixed central-value truth smeared by each member's own A_C. Statistical reference = DataStats covariance of the
